status: Partial research only. No full posted task proved, no upstream pull request submitted, and no project contribution credit claimed.

results.result: Every representing circuit for the specified 45-by-45 cycle-family matrix has at least 90 gates.
results.limitation: Task L-meta-10075 asks for at least 100 gates; this result does not solve it.

results.result: An explicit 16-gate AND/OR circuit computes threshold-two on seven inputs; it replaces any candidate of at least 16 gates. A NOT-free circuit is its own replacement.
results.limitation: Does not settle the at-most-15-gate cases in L-meta-10453.

results.result: Two semantic conditions allow a single NOT output to be replaced by a constant.
The two semantic conditions give actual circuit replacements with equal gate count and no NOT gates.
An explicit 104-gate circuit for the 45-by-45 matrix.
results.limitation: The auxiliary Lean check was stopped without a verdict. This is computational evidence, not a checked theorem.

search_outcomes: No counterexample was found. Full-problem SAT timeouts are inconclusive; local-window UNSAT results apply only to their restricted encodings.
excluded: Unfinished proofs, placeholder files, compiled artifacts, credentials, lease identifiers, and toolchain/cache downloads are not included.
